title: Statutory price revision
description: Material input prices were revised following a documented statutory price-index adjustment.

rationale.reason: Contractual price-adjustment clause and published price index revision.

title: Authority-related schedule extension
description: Work was extended after utility shifting was delayed by the authority.

rationale.reason: Utility relocation was not completed within the planned handover window.
rationale.evidence: Site instruction SI-118 + Utility shifting report dated 2026-06-04

title: Material specification change
description: A revised pavement specification was introduced for part of the corridor.

rationale.reason: Amendment refers to field conditions, but supporting technical approval is not attached.
rationale.evidence: Amendment A-03; technical approval document not found

title: Scope and contractor variation
description: A portion of the remaining work was reassigned and the scope was adjusted.

changes.contractor: Apex Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd. + Delta Civil Works
changes.scope: Construction and resurfacing of 12 km corridor with drainage improvements on 2 km

rationale.reason: Additional drainage work was requested after site inspection.
rationale.evidence: Site inspection note SIN-44; procurement approval for subcontracted works not attached
